sentences.en: Someone ploughed into me from behind at an intersection yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天在交叉路口，有人从后面开车撞了我。

sentences.en: Better to have one plough going than two cradles.
sentences.zh: 与其有两个摇篮，不如有一个犁。

sentences.en: If ploughing was a matter of gazing, anybody will thresh wheat.
sentences.zh: 如果耕作只需要盯着看，那么任何人都能脱粒小麦。
